text: Rayan Roshan is a Computer Science student based in the Greater Toronto Area in Ontario, Canada.
Rayan is pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science at Toronto Metropolitan University with an expected graduation in 2029.
Rayan completed his Ontario Secondary School Diploma at St. Edmund Campion Secondary School.
Rayan follows a personal philosophy of keeping systems simple, functional, and focused on real-world impact.
Rayan builds real-world software solutions with a focus on clean code, strong user experience, scalability, and continuous learning.
Rayan's core focus areas include mobile development, full-stack engineering, artificial intelligence, and machine learning systems.
Rayan's programming languages include JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, Swift, HTML, and CSS.
Rayan has frontend experience using React, Vite, React Router, Framer Motion, and modern CSS-based UI design.
Rayan has backend experience using Node.js, Express, Firebase, Azure services, REST APIs, and stateless backend architectures.
Rayan has hands-on experience with AI systems including OpenAI APIs, Google Gemini, Whisper speech-to-text, vector embeddings, RAG pipelines, LLM chaining, and fine-tuning.
Rayan regularly uses Git, GitHub, VS Code, Docker, Figma, ESLint, Vercel, Azure, and Google Cloud tooling.
Rayan is the founder and iOS developer of Univ, a platform designed to help students navigate post-secondary admissions.
Univ was built using Swift for iOS, Firebase for backend services, Gemini AI for intelligent features, and Azure cloud infrastructure.
Rayan shipped the Univ MVP in under four months and secured $5,000 in Azure credits through Microsoft Startup Founder Hub.
Univ includes a database of over 50 institutions and provides students with personalized school recommendations and admissions insights.
Rayan is an incoming Technology Consulting ServiceNow intern at Ernst and Young, where he configures and tests ServiceNow modules and supports proposals with documentation.
As a Software Engineering Resident at Headstarter, Rayan built multiple AI, machine learning, and full-stack projects using JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, and Vercel.
At Headstarter, Rayan implemented LLM chaining and fine-tuning techniques to improve latency, accuracy, and reliability across AI systems.
Rayan serves as a Project Experience Lead at TMU BYTE, where he designs AI and ML roadmaps and mentors over ten contributors.
Rayan has participated in entrepreneurship programs including DMZ, Innovation Boost Zone, and Microsoft Startup Founder Hub.
Rayan built an AI customer support agent supporting real-time voice and text interaction, live transcription, and context-aware responses using Gemini, OpenAI, and vector embeddings.
The AI customer support agent achieved approximately 95 percent transcription accuracy and significantly improved response relevance using Pinecone and Gemini embeddings.
Rayan built an AI-powered finance wellness application using React, Node.js, Gemini AI, and the Plaid API for real-time banking integration.
Rayan developed an AI-powered prior authorization automation system for healthcare documents using Gemini to extract structured data with high accuracy.
Rayan worked on a multimodal video analysis system that enables users to chat with videos, generate timestamps, and search scenes using NLP and computer vision.
Rayan developed a property recommendation system in Python using feature similarity and statistical analysis to identify comparable properties.
Rayan is the founder and engineer of AskCents, a personal finance coaching platform featuring an AI chatbot and gamified rewards.
Rayan co-founded Yapp, a real-time social platform for Toronto Metropolitan University students focused on messaging and event coordination.
Rayan contributed to research analyzing child care accessibility for over 700,000 immigrant families in the Greater Toronto Area.
Rayan placed third at the Scotiabank S:Hacks hackathon and has received academic and innovation awards including Ontario Scholar and IBZ funding.
Rayan has demonstrated leadership through mentorship, student representation roles, and organizing academic and professional events.
Rayan maintains a personal portfolio website, multiple GitHub repositories, and a professional LinkedIn presence.
